# Idea To PR

The coordinating session owns user communication, scope and approval decisions,
plan-folder state, work assignment, handoffs, supervision, and reporting.

Build validated pull requests through discovery, planning, implementation, and review.
For security, architecture, design, and complex migration work, record evidence.
